question: The effect of AMP-dependent protein kinase (AMPK) on lipid metabolism is:

options.opa: Activate cholesterol synthesis, by phosphorylation of hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA reductase (HMG-CoA network).
options.opb: Activate lipolysis in adipose tissue, through the phosphorylation of lipoprotein lipase (LPL).
options.opc: Inhibit beta-oxidation of fatty acids, by phosphorylation of acyl-CoA dehydrogenase.
options.opd: Inhibit lipogenesis by phosphorylation of acetyl-CoA carboxylase (ACC).

analysis: AMP-dependent protein kinase (AMPK) is known to inhibit lipogenesis by phosphorylating acetyl-CoA carboxylase (ACC), which in turn reduces the production of malonyl-CoA, a precursor for fatty acid synthesis. This ultimately leads to a decrease in lipid synthesis.
